chunks.title: Redacted CV
chunks.text: Built secure claim-intake and review services combining claim details, policy data, uploaded documents, customer notes, and status updates through cloud-hosted APIs. Developed AI-assisted claim review features for summarization, document extraction, missing-information detection, fraud-signal indicators, and routing recommendations. Implemented a retrieval-augmented internal assistant for policy rules, coverage conditions, partner guidelines, and operational documentation. Delivered React dashboard features for claim queues, review status, customer submissions, policy details, processing history, and reviewer workflows. Used PostgreSQL and Redis for claim records, cached policy data, workflow status, user sessions, and fast lookups. Deployed and monitored services on AWS with secure environment configuration, logging, monitoring, and CloudWatch alerts. Reduced API latency by up to 70 percent through query optimization, Redis caching, request validation, structured logging, retry logic, and monitoring. Evaluated AI output for summary accuracy, hallucination risk, missing-field detection, and human-review escalation. Worked with product, QA, and insurance operations to test edge cases and reduce manual review friction.

chunks.title: Redacted CV
chunks.text: Built merchant portal features for transaction search, payment status, refund history, settlement summaries, onboarding, and account setup. Developed REST APIs for merchant transactions, installment plans, refunds, customer payment activity, and settlement records. Built frontend modules with React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, and reusable components. Improved onboarding forms, validation, profile updates, error handling, and store configuration workflows. Designed dashboard widgets for transaction volume, pending and failed payments, refunds, and settlement status. Used PostgreSQL and Redis for transaction lookup, merchant settings, user sessions, and frequently accessed payment data. Reduced API latency by up to 70 percent through query optimization, caching, request validation, and monitoring. Supported QA, operations, releases, code reviews, production support, and iterative delivery.
